messages.content: finally home ugh
same, took me forever to get out of the parking lot
did you end up staying late?
yeah like 20 mins, nothing crazy
nice, I'm just heating up leftovers
what'd you have?
that veggie stir fry from yesterday, still pretty good
oh nice, I had a sad desk salad lol
lol classic
hey we still need to catch up properly soon
yes! it's been too long
wanna do something easy like pizza on Friday?
yes please, I'm craving pizza
same, how about Rosa's on Oak Street?
oh I love that place
right? their garlic knots are dangerous
seriously, I always eat too many
okay so Friday at 1 pm?
yeah that works for me
perfect
are you working from home that day?
yeah, so I can just walk over
nice, I'm in office but I can slip out for lunch
how long can you stay?
probably like an hour, hour and a half?
that's plenty
did you see they redid the patio there?
no! is it nice now?
yeah way more tables, less wobbly chairs lol
thank god those chairs were scary
right?
btw are you still doing that pottery class?
yeah tomorrow night is week 3
how's it going?
messy but fun, my bowl looks lopsided
that's the charm tho
that's what the teacher says too lol
my sister wants to join one, I'll send her your studio
yes do it, Tuesday guy is super chill
oh cool, I'll tell her
what are you up to tomorrow?
just work and laundry, thrilling stuff
lol same, I need to water my plants too they're dying
oh no, my basil already gave up
RIP basil
lol it'll be resurrected from the grocery store
hahaha fair
okay so I'm excited for Friday, been craving their pepperoni
same, I'm getting a side salad to pretend I'm healthy
lol get the knots too, balance
exactly, perfect balance
okay gonna go eat before this gets cold, talk later?
